content:
nina: :rotating_light: us-west2 is failing to attach GPUs for Dedicated provisioning. We see KMS errors on attach (timeout / 5xx). Impact: new Dedicated pools in us-west2 can't finish provisioning and some existing attaches are flapping.
infra-bot: Alert: attach-failure-rate(us-west2) > 4% in last 5m. 12 distinct hosts reporting KMS timeouts.
kevin: grabbing logs, oncall investigating. Can someone paste the attach error snippet?
sam: paste from controller logs:
```
ERROR attach_controller.go:142: attach failed: err=KMSAccessError{code=504, msg="peer KMS unreachable"}
trace=grpc://kms-proxy.us-west2:443 -> dial timeout
```
kevin: confirming — looks like cloud-provider peering to KMS endpoints is degraded, not our KMS keys themselves. aws-status-bot any updates?
aws-status-bot: https://status.cloud-provider.example/incidents/78910 - "Networking issue impacting KMS peering in us-west2. Customers may see KMS timeouts and attach failures."
maria: security note: do not fallback to plaintext disk. If we need a crypto fallback, use locally-wrapped short-lived DEKs and audit every operation. I'll approve emergency flow if we keep TTL <= 1h and log to audit stream.
eli: immediate mitigation proposal:
- Stop new attach attempts in us-west2 (fail fast).
- Shift new provisioning to eu-west1 and us-east1 via routing control plane.
- Enable cached DEK fallback path for already-running nodes (reads only).
- Pre-warm extra Dedicated GPU pools in eu-west1 to absorb traffic.
kevin: agree. Initiating fail-fast on attach: `kubectl -n infra set env deployment/attach-controller ATTACH_FAIL_FAST=true`
sam: starting traffic shift: hitting routing API to change weights:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_TOKEN" https://control.redwood.internal/v1/routing/region-weights -d '{"us-west2":10,"eu-west1":60,"us-east1":30}'
```
eli: making change now — moving 60% of new Dedicated provisioning to eu-west1, 30% to us-east1, leaving 10% (test) in us-west2.
kevin: pre-warming note: provisioning extra 8x A100 nodes in eu-west1 will cost ~+$18k/day while hot. Ops/Billing, ack? :money_with_wings:
cloud-sr: we've opened SR-14222 with provider support, escalation to network infra team. ETA from provider currently 45-90m.
maria: approve cached-DEK runtime flow as emergency: details uploaded to /runbooks/kms-fallback-emergency (internal). Keep TTL=30m and require audit flag.
eli: implementing cached-DEK fallback on attach-controller (hot patch):
```
patch apply attach-controller  -> enable flag --allow-cached-dek
# server will attempt cached DEK unwrap if KMS times out, then log event: dek_source=cached emergency=true
```
infra-bot: Event: route-change applied by sam at 1865438120; attach-controller mod by kevin at 1865438205.
kevin: monitoring errors and latency. attach failure rate dropped to 0.8% after routing change and fail-fast. GPU provisioning throughput stabilized but at lower headroom.
sam: note: some legacy Dedicated nodes have long-lived software-wrapped keys disabled — we'll need a small manual migration for them post-incident.
maria: create ticket for post-mortem on key handling and runbook updates. Security will need timeline and all audit logs.
eli: logs show provider ack at 1865439000, "peering route re-established" in provider console, KMS timeouts falling. We'll keep routing change for extra 30 minutes then gradually return weight to us-west2.
kevin: rolling back weights to normal over 20m window, monitoring token attach SLOs.
nina: great work. Followups assigned:
- sam: cost/risk analysis for pre-warm policy (due EOD).
- eli: postmortem + timeline (priority).
- maria: audit bundle and security sign-off.
- kevin: verify provider SR closure and runbook patch.
closing note: incident severity lowered to advisory. Will keep channel open until all followups are in tracker. :white_check_mark:
